data.one_liner: High-level API for widget testing built on top of flutter_test.
data.what_it_does: Provides custom finders and concise actions like tap, enterText, and scroll for Flutter widget tests. Wraps actions with patrol_log for better step reporting.
use_when: You need more readable and expressive widget tests
You want built‑in logging of test steps
You require cross‑platform support including web and desktop
avoid_when: You only run unit tests without UI
You prefer the raw flutter_test API
You need a testing framework for integration tests beyond widget level
weaknesses: Adds another abstraction layer over flutter_test
Relies on patrol_log which may add overhead

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard testing package with no extra abstraction
